name: Black Panther
caption: Doesn't count steps. Steps count him.
frenchCaption: Ne compte pas ses pas. Ses pas le comptent.
rosterName: Black Panther with the gold chain
description: A muscular black panther with jet-black fur, charcoal-grey muzzle, white whiskers, yellow eyes, rounded ears and a long black tail curled at the tip, wearing a chunky gold chain and no headband.

name: Lone Wolf
caption: Runs alone. Finishes first.
frenchCaption: Court seul. Finit premier.
rosterName: Lone Wolf with silver hoop earring
description: A stocky grey wolf with grizzled grey-brown fur, cream muzzle, cheeks and chest, dark markings around pale yellow eyes, tall pointed ears, a silver hoop earring in one ear and a bushy grey tail.

name: Snow Leopard
caption: Cold start. Hot finish.
frenchCaption: Départ à froid. Arrivée brûlante.
description: A stocky snow leopard with pale grey-cream fur covered in dark rosettes and spots, icy blue eyes, small rounded ears, a long thick spotted tail and cream-framed blue ski goggles pushed up on its forehead.

name: Tiger
caption: Wraps on. Excuses off.
frenchCaption: Bandages mis. Excuses au placard.
description: A sturdy Bengal tiger with bright orange fur and bold black stripes, white muzzle, cheeks and chest, pink nose, amber eyes, a striped black-tipped tail and red hand wraps instead of wristbands.

name: Night Owl
caption: Up at 3 a.m. Still ahead of you.
frenchCaption: Debout à 3 h du matin. Toujours devant toi.
rosterName: Night Owl with round gold glasses
description: A plump great horned owl with mottled brown and tan feathers, an orange-tan facial disc, tall feathered ear tufts, yellow eyes, a dark hooked beak and round gold wire-rim glasses.

name: Crocodile
caption: Smiles at the finish line. Bad sign.
frenchCaption: Sourit à l’arrivée. Mauvais signe.
description: A stocky olive-green crocodile with bumpy scaly hide, a paler cream throat and belly, a long snout with jagged white teeth, a ridged spiky back and thick tail, and black rectangular sunglasses.

name: Peacock
caption: Dressed to win. Also wins.
frenchCaption: Habillé pour gagner. Et il gagne.
description: A proud peacock with iridescent royal-blue feathers, white eye stripes, a fanned blue crest, a huge green eyespot tail fan, gold aviator sunglasses with amber lenses and no headband.

name: Flamingo
caption: Stands on one leg. Still out-walks you.
frenchCaption: Tient sur une patte. Marche quand même plus que toi.
description: A slender flamingo with ruffled coral-pink feathers, a long curved neck, long pink legs, a black-tipped hooked beak and cream heart-shaped sunglasses with dark lenses.

name: Persian Cat
caption: Pearls on. Pinky up. Pace up.
frenchCaption: Perles au cou. Petit doigt levé. Allure en hausse.
rosterName: Persian Cat with the pearl necklace
description: A plump, very fluffy cream-white Persian cat with a flat face, copper-orange eyes, small pink-lined ears, a huge bushy tail and a pearl necklace.

name: Ostrich
caption: Never buries her head. Only the competition.
frenchCaption: Ne se cache jamais la tête. Elle enterre la concurrence.
description: A tall ostrich with a long bare pinkish neck, fuzzy pale head, long-lashed eyes, pink beak, dark brown body plumage with cream wing tips, gold hoop earrings and no headband.

name: Cheetah
caption: Fashionably fast. Never fashionably late.
frenchCaption: Rapide avec élégance. En retard, jamais.
description: A lean, athletic cheetah with golden-tan fur covered in black spots, black tear-streak lines, a white muzzle, a long ringed black-tipped tail, a dark red neckerchief and no headband.

name: Bald Eagle
caption: Spotted your step count from up here.
frenchCaption: A repéré ton nombre de pas de là-haut.
rosterName: Bald Eagle with the navy neckerchief
description: A sturdy bald eagle with a white feathered head and tail, dark brown body and wings, a hooked yellow beak, yellow eyes, a navy-blue neckerchief and no headband.

name: Silverback
caption: Skips nothing. Especially not leg day.
frenchCaption: Ne saute rien. Surtout pas la séance jambes.
description: A hulking gorilla with shaggy grizzled charcoal-grey fur, a bare dark grey face and chest, a bushy grey tail, wearing an orange-and-cream striped headband and no wristbands.

name: Kangaroo
caption: Counts jumps as steps. Nobody argues.
frenchCaption: Compte ses sauts comme des pas. Personne ne discute.
description: A lean, muscular kangaroo with rusty orange fur, a cream chest and muzzle, tall pointed cream-lined ears, a black nose, a long thick tail and red boxing gloves.

name: Bull
caption: Charges first. Asks questions never.
frenchCaption: Fonce d’abord. Ne pose jamais de questions.
rosterName: Bull with the gold nose ring
description: A stocky, muscular bull with shaggy black-brown fur, long upturned cream horns, pink-lined ears, a pinkish-grey muzzle with a gold nose ring, a tufted tail, and no headband or wristbands.

name: Moose
caption: Coach says one more lap. Coach is me.
frenchCaption: Le coach dit encore un tour. Le coach, c’est moi.
description: A burly moose with shaggy brown fur, huge tan palmate antlers, a big bulbous tan muzzle, a short tail and a silver coach's whistle on a dark cord, no headband or wristbands.

name: Bison
caption: Skipping rope. Never skipping cardio.
frenchCaption: Saute à la corde. Ne saute jamais le cardio.
description: A hulking bison with shaggy rusty-brown fur, a thick mane and beard, short curved cream horns, a dark muzzle, a tufted tail, a cream jump rope with green handles over one shoulder, no headband or wristbands.

name: Camel
caption: Hydrated in 2019. Still going.
frenchCaption: Hydraté en 2019. Toujours en route.
rosterName: Camel with the green water bottle
description: A sturdy dromedary camel with sandy tan fur, a single hump, a tufted forelock, small round ears, a pale muzzle, a tufted tail and a green water bottle, no headband or wristbands.

name: Panda
caption: Bubble tea first. Then domination.
frenchCaption: Bubble tea d’abord. Domination ensuite.
description: A chubby giant panda with cream-white fur, black eye patches, ears, arms and legs, a black nose, holding a bubble tea cup with a green straw.

name: Capybara
caption: Unbothered. Undefeated.
frenchCaption: Imperturbable. Invaincu.
rosterName: Capybara with a yuzu on top
description: A stocky barrel-bodied capybara with coarse warm-brown fur, a dark blunt muzzle, small round ears, long whiskers and a yellow yuzu with a green leaf balanced on its head.

name: Hedgehog
caption: Prickly before coffee. Fast after.
frenchCaption: Piquant avant le café. Rapide après.
description: A stout hedgehog with spiky brown-and-cream quills, tan furry face and limbs, small round ears, a black nose, no wristbands and a steaming cream pine-tree cocoa mug.

name: Ginger Cat
caption: Woke up at noon. Won by dinner.
frenchCaption: Réveillé à midi. Vainqueur avant le dîner.
rosterName: Ginger Cat with the cereal bowl
description: A chubby ginger tabby with darker orange stripes, cream muzzle and chest, pink nose, tufted ears, a bushy ringed tail and a green-striped cereal bowl with a spoon.

name: Alpaca
caption: Spits on rest days only.
frenchCaption: Ne crache que les jours de repos.
description: A slim long-necked alpaca with fluffy cream fleece, a woolly topknot, tall pointed ears with pink insides, a pom-pom tail and round gold-rimmed green-tinted sunglasses.

name: Seal
caption: Warm flippers. Cold competition.
frenchCaption: Nageoires au chaud. Concurrence au frais.
description: A plump grey harbor seal with dark spots all over, a lighter grey face, long whiskers, a black nose, no ears, no headband or wristbands, clutching a red hot-water bottle.

name: Hamster
caption: Small legs. Unreasonable cardio.
frenchCaption: Petites pattes. Cardio déraisonnable.
rosterName: Hamster with the green soda can
description: A plump golden hamster with fluffy orange fur, cream cheeks, chin and chest, round pink-lined ears, a pink nose and a green soda can in one paw.

name: Tree Frog
caption: Hops count double. Allegedly.
frenchCaption: Les sauts comptent double. Paraît-il.
description: A red-eyed tree frog with bright lime-green skin, cream throat and belly, big red eyes with black pupils, blue-and-yellow flank streaks, orange toe pads and an orange basketball.

name: Mouse
caption: Small steps. So many of them.
frenchCaption: Petits pas. Tellement nombreux.
description: A grey mouse with soft grey fur, huge round pink-lined ears, a pink nose, long whiskers, a long pink tail, no headband or wristbands, holding a yellow Swiss cheese wedge.

name: Guinea Pig
caption: Squeaks politely. Walks relentlessly.
frenchCaption: Couine poliment. Marche sans relâche.
rosterName: Guinea Pig with a lettuce leaf
description: A plump tricolour guinea pig with orange, dark brown and white patches, a white face blaze, pink petal ears, no headband or wristbands, and a green lettuce leaf.

name: Duck
caption: Small duck. Big lift. Bigger quack.
frenchCaption: Petit canard. Grosse barre. Coin-coin encore plus gros.
description: A stocky white duck with cream feathers, a spiky crest tuft, a broad orange bill, orange legs, a wide dark leather belt with silver buckle, and no headband or wristbands.

name: Donkey
caption: Stubborn about cardio. In a good way.
frenchCaption: Têtu sur le cardio. Dans le bon sens.
description: A lanky grey-brown donkey with shaggy fur, pale muzzle, dark forelock, tall dark-rimmed ears, dark tufted tail, no wristbands, and a green-banded straw hat instead of a headband.
